description: Fork of exp513 (qk hardened argmax TinyMHLut). ONLY change: qk_lut param-matched reshape nap 4->5, tph 256->128 (2^nap*tph: 16*256 = 32*128 = 4096, unchanged; total 89.39M). Fifth point on the qk wide-shallow-vs-deep curve at fixed 4096-entry budget, approaching exp508's soft nap=6: exp511 nap2/tph1024=1.4862, exp512 nap3/tph512=1.4888, exp513 nap4/tph256=1.4825 (best so far), exp519 nap5/tph128=?. NAP=5 = 32 rows/table x 128 tables. Tests whether the nap=4 sweet spot holds or nap=5 is better as we near the soft nap=6 region. vs exp513 1.4825, exp508 1.4840 (soft qk), exp475 1.4962 (all argmax ref).
